text: {"lessons":["I’ve repeatedly sold stocks for gains, but those sales alone haven’t stopped my account value from falling; I should judge decisions by the portfolio’s overall prospects, not just a position’s gain.","Selling winners feels satisfying, but I may be cutting them short; I should set reasons to sell based on fundamentals and risk rather than the comfort of locking in a profit.","I bought Stock D again after selling it, then sold it for a small gain; I should avoid reacting to each month’s price and make deliberate decisions that account for trading frequency and diversification."]}
